notes.title: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello BIT.TRIP fans!

We have a nice little update that includes some improvements to the Community Zone's UI and some graphical enhancements. We also thought we would add some levels for the Community, We added 3 levels! Look for the CP logo to identify them in the sea of AWESOMENESS! 

For a detailed tutorial on how to use these wonderful new features, head to our online tutorial here: https://www.rerunner.game/tutorial

As always, join our active fan community on Discord: HERE!

ABOUT RERUNNER:

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER is a captivating rhythm platformer that transports players into a mesmerizing world of retro-style graphics and infectious beats. Players control Commandervideo, navigating through levels filled with obstacles, synchronized perfectly to the pulsating rhythm of the music. Each jump, slide, and dodge must be timed precisely to the beat, creating a seamless fusion of gameplay and music that keeps players immersed in the experience. With its addictive gameplay, stylish visuals, and toe-tapping soundtrack, BIT.TRIP RERUNNER offers an exhilarating journey for players looking for a unique and engaging gaming experience.

+RUNNER MAKER & +MUSIC MAKER

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER's innovative features extend beyond its captivating gameplay to include the dynamic +RUNNER MAKER and +MUSIC MAKER tools. With +RUNNER MAKER, players step into the role of game designers, empowered to craft their own levels filled with challenges and obstacles. This creative freedom allows players to personalize their gaming experience and share their creations with the vibrant community, fostering an endless array of unique and exciting levels. The +MUSIC MAKER enables the player to customize the game's soundtrack. With this tool, players can create and integrate their own music compositions into the game, further enhancing the immersive experience and adding a personal touch to their gameplay journey. Together, these innovative tools not only enhance player creativity but also foster a sense of community and collaboration within the BIT.TRIP RERUNNER universe!

But how crazy is it? (It's fairly crazy)

notes.title: Patch 2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Our second patch is now live! Here are the changes:


 Added various BPM versions of the No Music BGM (132, 160, 200)
 Improved the difficulty rating formula for custom levels
 Added a limit of 50 objects per tile in RUNNER MAKER
 Fixed being able to delete gold bars in Low ! Density
 Improvements to showing why certain Community Zone features are locked
 Made Tile 10’s collision outline in RUNNER MAKER match the tile’s in-game collision
 Fixed an issue with Mode Up voices playing when they shouldn’t
 Fixed playing from checkpoint not working with keyboard as well as other RUNNER MAKER keyboard improvements
 Made song lists in RUNNER MAKER and player level filters match
 Fixed Boogie text occasionally staying on screen forever
 Fixed long level names overlapping the Community Zone text in the Challenge Complete header
 Centered level names at the start of levels (finally!)*
 Fixed Words entries in the Extras Menu overlapping the button list
 Added ability to randomize Player Titles in the Community Zone
 General bug fixes


*That one had been bugging me for months!
